spaces.description: By space: where drafted documents go (phase 4 section 4.5). The knowledge instance's drafter entry, [plugins.knowledge.config.drafters.<instance>.targets.<space>], must name the same target, and it is the one enforced: a create anywhere else is refused, never written. A space with no target is CURATOR_TARGET_UNCONFIGURED

collection.description: A markdown collection of the space

prefix.description: Optional. One to eight plain segments joined by /: lowercase letters, digits, - and _, no dots, no leading or trailing /. A draft is <collection>/<prefix>/<derived id>

model.description: Reserved (phase 4 section 8.5): no model drafts or extracts in phase 4. Any value other than null makes every curator command answer CURATOR_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
